regions.purpose: Names the Entry by its Location and holds the Entry-level affordances — Back and the trashcan that removes the Entry via an inline two-tap confirm.

A single tappable row beneath the title that surfaces the owning Collection — a color dot painted from the Collection's appearance color followed by the Collection name. The whole row routes to CollectionDetail.
The Entry's Location — display name, coordinates, cached provider metadata — as a tappable row that peeks the Location on the map, plus a button that hands off to an external map app.

The Entry's Review, shown as the full template field set. The body is non-interactive so users can select and copy text; a pencil icon on the right edge opens the ReviewForm. Renders one of two states: reviewed (the user has saved data) or unreviewed (the Location is in the Collection but not yet evaluated — every field shown unset).

affordances.label: Remove the Collection Entry
affordances.notes: Rendered as a trashcan icon. First tap reveals an inline 'Delete Entry?' label next to the icon; second tap (while armed) fires the removal. Tapping outside the icon dismisses the armed state.

affordances.label: View the Location on the map
Open in an external map app
Edit the Review
affordances.notes: Rendered as a pencil icon on the right edge of the Review header. The review body itself is non-reactive so text remains selectable.

shows: the field's value, rendered for its type, or an unset marker when empty

lists.emptyState: When the Entry is unreviewed, every template field shows unset and the region prompts the user toward Edit the Review.
